nodes.label: vasp_auto Engine (single source of truth)
nodes.rationale: The engine package is the only source of truth; CLI and UI call the same functions so they behave identically. Core stays pure-Python (no numpy), installable without ASE/fairchem.

nodes.label: Workflow-builder GUI Goal
nodes.rationale: Long-term goal: a GUI layer letting users pick a calc type, adjust params via forms, chain tasks, and view results without writing an INCAR by hand; must stay fully backward-compatible with the CLI.

nodes.label: Execution Model - Local vs Remote
nodes.rationale: runner.py owns all execution (local subprocess + everything SSH/remote); every calculate path must stay available on both local and any configured remote. Standing rule: don't put SSH calls outside runner.py.

nodes.label: Three Remote Run Modes (scheduler / ssh / ssh_detached)
nodes.rationale: scheduler (sbatch/qsub over SSH, laptop-off safe), ssh (synchronous mpirun, not laptop-off safe), ssh_detached (whole engine under setsid, laptop-off safe). Detached records the wrapper rc, so rc=0 does not mean VASP succeeded.

nodes.label: Cross-machine Job Control (terminate/delete/resume)
nodes.rationale: One endpoint per action; the row's machine field selects local vs remote and the server acts over SSH for remote rows. Destructive remote paths validated against remote_root, local ones against jobs_root - boundary always from server config, never the client.

nodes.label: Job Status as Liveness Check (not file existence)
nodes.rationale: A job reads 'running' only if its recorded .pid is alive (kill -0) or a live process has its cwd inside the dir; 'done' needs a genuine finish signal (job.log / OUTCAR footer / QE JOB DONE / ase_results.json); dead-without-finishing is 'stalled'. The same rule lives in three places (local, remote shell walk, terminal_status) so every view agrees.

nodes.label: Quantum ESPRESSO (pw.x) Engine
nodes.rationale: Open-source engine so users without a VASP licence can run the same cases; selected by engine=qe with a .engine marker file per job dir; works through all three remote run modes. NEB/phonon/convergence/chaining stay VASP-only.

hyperedges.label: Remote Execution and Job Lifecycle (run modes, control, liveness, capture)
